name: conceptpowers
description: Concept-driven development governance: define concepts before code; agents review changes against them and a commit gate keeps concepts, code links and evidence in step

interface.shortDescription: Concept-first governance that keeps code aligned with its concepts
interface.longDescription: Define concepts (allow / restrict / immutable rules) before writing code, verify changes against them, and gate commits when code drifts from its concepts. Dormant until a project opts in with docs/conceptpowers/init.json.
defaultPrompt: Enable concept governance on this project.
Check whether this change follows its concepts.
Find code that is not covered by any concept.
